research experience.name: Music and Audio Computing Lab, KAIST
research experience.summary:
Research Intern
Advisor: Eunjin Choi, Prof. Juhan Nam
highlights: Developed AImoclips, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating how well text-to-music (TTM) generation systems convey intended emotions to human listeners. The benchmark offers valuable insights into model-specific emotion rendering characteristics and supports future development of emotionally aligned TTM systems.

research experience.name: Department of Mathematics, UCLA
research experience.summary:
Research Intern
Advisor: Hyunsik Chae, Prof. Ernest Ryu
highlights: Developed AVSBench, a benchmark for evaluating visual understanding ability of visual language models(VLMs) by decomposing it into atomic visual skills. Found that VLMs struggle with most of these atomic visual skills that are obvious to humans.

research experience.name: Music and Audio Research Group, Seoul National University
highlights: Implemented and tested Theme Transformer, a Transformer-based music generation framework conditioned on a small, thematic musical piece that generates symbolic music consistent with the theme.

research experience.name: Human-Computer Interaction Lab, Seoul National University
research experience.summary:
UROP(Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program) Student

highlights: Developed UMATO, a novel dimension reduction algorithm for data visualization and evaluated its scalability.

research experience.name: International Research Institute for Cyber Security

additional experience.name: AttentionX, an AI Research & Startup Group
